answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the quartz graph. Re-attestations are stored in horizon and kernel lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1328 identities would post 2053 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
